data.name: Eugen
data.gender_notes: Eugen is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word eugenēs, meaning 'well-born' or 'noble'. In the New Testament, Eugenios is a name given to a Roman soldier who converted to Christianity. The name Eugen carries the meaning “Well-born, noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eugen usually hope their child will grow to embody well-born, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the spirit of nobility, kindness, and faith.
data.etymology: Eugen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Well-born, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eugen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אוגן
in_hebrew.meaning: מוליד טוב, נושא טוב, מביא טוב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אוגן מקורו במילה היוונית 'εὐγενής' (אאוגנס) שפירושה 'מוליד טוב' או 'נושא טוב'. השם אוגן משמש בשפה העברית ומשמעותו מביא טוב או מוליד טוב, ויש לו קונוטציות חיוביות של טוב וצדקה. השם אוגן לא מופיע ישירות בתנ"ך, אך הוא קשור למושגים של טוב וצדקה, שמהווים ערכים מרכזיים ביהדות ובנצרות.

in_greek.name: Εὐγέν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εὐγέν προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'εὐγενής' (eugeness), που σημαίνει 'καλογονημένος' ή 'ευγενής'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια λέξεις σχετίζονται με την έννοια της καλής καταγωγής και της αρετής. Το όνομα Εὐγέν χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην Εκκλησία Πρωτοχριστιανική και συμβολίζει την πνευματική καλοσύνη και την αρετή.

in_latin.name: Eugen
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Eugen derives from the Latin term 'eugenēs', which translates to 'well-born' or 'noble'. In the early Christian Church, names carrying such meanings were often associated with virtues and good lineage. The name Eugen reflects the ideals of nobility and moral excellence highly valued in Christian tradition.

in_english.name: Eugen
in_english.meaning: well-born, noble, or good in birth
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eugen originates from the Greek word 'εὐγενής' (eugeness), meaning 'well-born' or 'noble'. It carries connotations of good lineage and moral excellence. Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Eugen reflects Christian values of nobility, virtue, and goodness. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures to signify a person of good character and spiritual nobility.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eugen, from its Greek origin, implies a sense of nobility and good birth. Historically, it was a name given to individuals who came from prestigious or high-ranking families. However, the name has evolved and is no longer limited to the aristocracy. Today, it is a name that can be given to any child regardless of their background, symbolizing the inherent worth and value of every human being.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Eugen holds a deeper meaning beyond nobility or good birth. It is a reminder of the new birth that comes through faith in Christ. As a Roman soldier named Eugenios is recorded in history as having converted to Christianity, the name represents the transformative power of faith and the hope for a better life that comes from following Christ. It is a name that encourages us to strive for spiritual growth and virtue, to be ‘born again’ in the image of God.
